recommendation_summary: Act now: replace in-memory counting with a PostgreSQL SELECT count(*) aggregate plus a partial index on unpaid rows, and verify latency stays under one second and the count includes an invoice committed just before the request. Kafka, CQRS and Redis are explicitly excluded from this week's work and deferred to a future workload with outside subscribers. No unmet needs are flagged.
note: The fix is the bounded aggregate query and it rejects the stack on freshness grounds, but the reply has none of the four required record labels.
